name: Red Baron
detail: Clock, power reset and watchdog are identical chip for chip on DP-156 sheet 02A and DP-169 sheet 02A. Verified by reading both, not inferred.

name: Red Baron Auxiliary Math Box
detail: Both use the same Math Box PCB with the same signature chart and device positions, so a known-good board from either game checks the other.

name: Tempest
detail: Two 8-position DIP banks each read onto the data bus through its own LS244 under OPT0/OPT1, plus a third LS244 for the coin door carrying 3KHZ and HALT.
